name: SMA Crossover Strategy - USD/JPY
description: 50/200 SMA crossover on USD/JPY daily bars. Long when 50-day SMA crosses above 200-day SMA, flat otherwise. Full allocation long-only.
source:
# SMA Crossover Strategy - EUR/USD
# 50/200 SMA crossover on EUR/USD daily bars
# Long when 50-day SMA > 200-day SMA, flat otherwise
# Full allocation long-only

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Signal Logic ---
# Fast (50-day) and Slow (200-day) SMA
fast_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Trend signal: bullish when fast > slow
is_bullish = fast_sma > slow_sma
is_bearish = fast_sma < slow_sma

# Hold position between crossover events
held = hold_until()(enter=is_bullish, exit=is_bearish)

# --- Execution (long-only, full allocation) ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
